41132e2c:  ;Transfer data from DGPM movement accounts
 ;
 ;This routine is automatically triggered by the PCE Event Driver (DGPMDDCV)
 ;when a patient movement account is created, updated, or cancelled.
 ;The process is called from event updater routine DGPMDDCV where the data
 ;from the DGPM movement requests are transferred to the PTF INCONSISTENT RECORD file.
 ;If needed, data in the later file will be transferred to appropriate movements.
 ;
 ;DGPMA - DGPM movement account node
 ;DGPMP - DGPM proposed movement node
 ;DGPMT - DGPM movement type
e2bb87c1: ;Initialize variables.
bd8b71d8: ;Flag to indicate incomplete records need to be updated.
1caca2f8: ;Process the DGPM movement types.
71dc9c6a: ;Cleanup and exit.
94ad8e9f: ;Exit the routine.

10c7ae46:  ;
 ;Start processing the movement requests.
 ;
 ;DGPMA - DGPM movement account node
 ;DGPMP - DGPM proposed movement node
 ;CA - Current admission IEN (DFN from file 2)
 ;DGPMT - DGPM movement type
664b8d5a: ;Get the current admission IEN.
b505d0a5: ;Get the DGPM movement type.
4a1527f9: ;If movement type is 1 (Admission) and no DGPMA node exists.
e0e163ae: ;Indicate incomplete records need to be updated.
4b1dc4d2: ;Reset flag to not update incomplete records.
37371ed1: ;Delete the incomplete/test record.
3f772026: ;Get current ward/division node.
5803c285: ;Set ward/division from the current ward/division node.
7f38ea2e: Skip record if ward/division not assigned or inactive.
c7987c58: If first pass through, display 'Updating incomplete records...' (unless suppressed by DGQUIET).
a3ee0e7c: If 6 node exists, extract subfinal node number.
1f018286: Process discharge information.
64d9cce9: Delete any existing admission records for this admission.
d547cc0e: Clean up variables used in ^DIK call.
6f3fd896: Initialize DR string.
abe5ac3b: Get admission IFN and quit if none found.
11ba6567: Check if active admission record already exists for this admission IFN.
d199a159: If active admission found, save IEN in DGJTDA.
a56de695: If transfer and admission and discharge data differ and no subfinal node exists, do change processing.
d34d01a5: If admit or readmission, and no active admission record exists, create new record (do change processing for readmission).
06b57fda: If admit, discharge record exists but no admission record, delete discharge record.
28e7c93d: If admit and admission/discharge data differ, do change processing.
d89d9fec: If the movement type is a transfer and there is an existing admission for the same patient with a different movement type, update the existing admission with the new admission data.
6ff41b08: If the movement type is a transfer, there is no existing admission, but there is a new admission record, create a new admission from the new admission record.
dc0b68d2: If the movement type is a transfer, and there are no other conditions to handle, quit.
3950b482: If there is an existing admission and the movement type is an admission, store the existing admission's internal entry number.
3bf5d4da: If there is an existing admission and the primary and secondary admission records for the surgical information file entry are different, update the existing admission.

72ee6368: If there is an existing admission and the primary and secondary admission records for the surgical information file entry are the same, but the admission source is different between the two, update the existing admission.
7c9454be: Kill all variables used in the routine.
bbcaa8b5: Retrieve the admission data from the patient movement file.
003936cf: Retrieve the division treatment date from the division file.
c8b796f1: Retrieve the ward for the admission from the ward file.
80a6c453: Retrieve the service for the admission from the service file.
4b7c0a70: If the service is not found, use the default service.
8c84f29b: Retrieve the admission comments from the division treatment date.
062e8940: Retrieve the additional admission comments based on the division treatment date.
d372d185: If the movement type indicates transfer or facility change, then do not process.
8823ff76: If an existing record was found, do not create a new one.
793f8fdb: Create a new record.
64db8615: Get the code for the 'INCOMPLETE' status.
e02fe899: If a new record was created, set up the record variables.
c3b947cc: Build the field values for the new record.
0def0681: Write the new record.
73934e3f: Clean up and quit.
c1d07288: If a movement type was specified, add the ward and division to the field values.
b340475c: Add the remaining field values and write the record.
a1061950: Clean up and quit.
b54f525f: Exit.
a02f53ea: Get the date field based on the movement type.
f839ffb4: Format the date value based on the date type code.
ff45c4fd: I X=''; sets blank node for admission type.
c9455d00: ;Updates if admission has changes.
c11b0ecf: ;Checks if admission has a valid transfer date/time.
add86427: ;If admission has a transfer date/time, retrieves the transfer date/time value.
a89280cb: ;Sets transfer date/time for updating admission record.
